```csharp using System; using System.Net; using System.Runtime.InteropServices; using Sick.GenIStream; using Sick.GenTL;

public sealed class Ruler3000Lines : IDisposable
{
    private CameraDiscovery _discovery;
    private ICamera _camera;
    private FrameGrabber _grabber;
    private IAnyParameters _p;
    private int _width = 0; // X pixel count
    public int WidthPixels => _width;

    public int timeoutMsPerFrame = 200; // GrabNext() timeout (waiting for external trigger)
    // ---- Connection ----
    public void Open(string ctiPath, string cameraIp)
    {
        _discovery = CameraDiscovery.CreateFromProducerFile(ctiPath);
        _camera = _discovery.ConnectTo(IPAddress.Parse(cameraIp));
        _p = _camera.GetAnyParameters();

        // Stop just in case
        TryExec("AcquisitionStop");
    }

    // ---- Pre-acquisition settings (External Trigger / Exposure / Height=1, etc.) ----
    // * Do not call during acquisition
    public void ConfigureForExternalTrigger(double exposureUs = 3000.0, string triggerLine = "Line1")
    {
        TryExec("AcquisitionStop");

        // Parent -> Child (Must is exception, Optional is suppressed)
        SetEnumMust("AcquisitionMode", "Continuous");

        SetEnumMust("TriggerMode", "On");
        TrySetEnum("TriggerSelector", "FrameStart");
        SetEnumMust("TriggerSource", triggerLine);
        TrySetEnum("TriggerActivation", "RisingEdge");

        TrySetEnum("LineSelector", triggerLine);
        TrySetEnum("LineMode", "Input");
        TrySetFloat("LineDebouncerTime", 5.0);

        TrySetEnum("ExposureAuto", "Off");
        SetFloatMust("ExposureTime", exposureUs);
        TrySetEnum("GainAuto", "Off");
        TrySetFloat("Gain", 0.0);

        // The base for line scan is Height=1 (If transferring multiple lines, >1)
        TrySetEnum("PixelFormat", "Mono32f"); // Ignored internally if not supported
        TrySetFloat("Height", 1.0);

        // Determine width
        _width = (int)Math.Round(GetFloatMust("Width"));
        if (_width <= 0) throw new InvalidOperationException("Failed to get Width.");

        _grabber?.Dispose();
        _grabber = _camera.CreateFrameGrabber();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Captures until the user-specified lineCount is reached and returns a height map (float) of shape [lineCount, Width].
    /// useTransformed=true: Returns a float conversion of the Z(mm) double source / false: Returns the U16 equivalent value packed into a float.
    /// If you want to save the data, you can call IFrame.Save(basePath) for each frame using onSaveIconPerFrame.
    /// </summary>
    public float[,] CaptureLinesTiled(
        int lineCount,
        int timeoutMsPerFrame = 200,
        bool useTransformed = false,
        Action<int, IFrame> onSaveIconPerFrame = null // e.g.: (i, f) => f.Save($@"C:\cap\frame_{i}")
    )
    {
        if (_grabber == null) throw new InvalidOperationException("Call ConfigureForExternalTrigger() first.");
        if (lineCount <= 0) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(lineCount));

        // Number of lines included in 1 frame (Height)
        int linesPerFrame = (int)Math.Round(GetFloatMust("Height"));
        if (linesPerFrame <= 0) linesPerFrame = 1;

        // Required number of frames (rounded up) = Same as HALCON's (LineCount + height -1) / height
        int loops = (lineCount + linesPerFrame - 1) / linesPerFrame;

        var hm = new float[lineCount, _width];
        int yWrite = 0;

        _grabber.Start();
        try
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < loops && yWrite < lineCount; i++)
            {
                var res = _grabber.GrabNext(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(timeoutMsPerFrame));

                res.IfCompleteFrame(frame =>
                {
                    try
                    {
                        ProcessCompletedFrame(
                            frameIndex: i,
                            frame: frame,
                            useTransformed: useTransformed,
                            hm: hm,
                            yWrite: ref yWrite,
                            lineCount: lineCount,
                            onSaveIconPerFrame: onSaveIconPerFrame
                        );
                    }
                    finally
                    {
                        frame.Release(); // Required for re-queue
                    }
                })
                .IfIncompleteFrame(f => { f.Release(); })
                .IfTimedOut(() => { /* e.g., Trigger not arrived */ });
            }
        }
        finally
        {
            _grabber.Stop();
        }

        return hm;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Processes a completed frame from GrabNext() and stacks it into the height map.
    /// ・Saves iCon if necessary (onSaveIconPerFrame)
    /// ・Gets Range and copies it to hm as U16 or double(mm)
    /// </summary>
    private void ProcessCompletedFrame(
        int frameIndex,
        IFrame frame,
        bool useTransformed,
        float[,] hm,
        ref int yWrite,
        int lineCount,
        Action<int, IFrame> onSaveIconPerFrame // nullable
    )
    {
        // 1) Save iCon (.dat + .xml) if necessary
        if (onSaveIconPerFrame != null) onSaveIconPerFrame(frameIndex, frame);

        // 2) Range component
        var range = frame.GetRange();
        if (range == null) return;

        // 3) Get IComponent (Raw U16 or Z[mm])
        var comp = useTransformed ? range.CopyTransformed()
                                : range.CopyUnpacked();

        uint w = comp.GetWidth();
        uint h = comp.GetDeliveredHeight();
        uint bpp = comp.GetBitsPerPixel();
        if (w == 0 || h == 0 || bpp == 0) return;

        // 4) Non-Image / Non-recommended API: Get raw data
        IntPtr ptr = comp.GetData();
        int bytes = checked((int)comp.GetDeliveredDataSize());
        if (ptr == IntPtr.Zero || bytes <= 0) return;

        var raw = new byte[bytes];
        Marshal.Copy(ptr, raw, 0, bytes);

        int ww = (int)w;
        int hh = (int)h;

        // 5) Stack into hm
        if (!useTransformed && bpp == 16)
        {
            // U16 -> float
            var u16 = new ushort[ww * hh];
            Buffer.BlockCopy(raw, 0, u16, 0, Math.Min(raw.Length, u16.Length * 2));

            for (int r = 0; r < hh && yWrite < lineCount; r++)
            {
                int off = r * ww;
                for (int x = 0; x < _width && x < ww; x++)
                    hm[yWrite, x] = u16[off + x]; // Apply scale/offset for mm conversion here if necessary
                yWrite++;
            }
        }
        else if (useTransformed && bpp == 64)
        {
            // double(mm) -> float
            var dbl = new double[ww * hh];
            Buffer.BlockCopy(raw, 0, dbl, 0, Math.Min(raw.Length, dbl.Length * 8));

            for (int r = 0; r < hh && yWrite < lineCount; r++)
            {
                int off = r * ww;
                for (int x = 0; x < _width && x < ww; x++)
                    hm[yWrite, x] = (float)dbl[off + x];
                yWrite++;
            }
        }
        else
        {
            // Add a branch here if other formats (e.g., 8/32bpp) arrive
        }
    }

    // ---- GenICam Node Helpers ----
    private void SetEnumMust(string name, string entry) { try { _p.SetEnum(name, entry); } catch (Exception ex) { throw new InvalidOperationException($"Failed to set {name}='{entry}': {ex.Message}"); } }
    private void SetFloatMust(string name, double v) { try { _p.SetFloat(name, (float)v); } catch (Exception ex) { throw new InvalidOperationException($"Failed to set {name}={v}: {ex.Message}"); } }
    private double GetFloatMust(string name) { try { return _p.GetFloat(name); } catch (Exception ex) { throw new InvalidOperationException($"Failed to read {name}: {ex.Message}"); } }
    private void TrySetEnum(string name, string entry) { try { _p.SetEnum(name, entry); } catch { } }
    private void TrySetFloat(string name, double v) { try { _p.SetFloat(name, (float)v); } catch { } }
    private void TryExec(string name) { try { _p.ExecuteCommand(name); } catch { } }

    // ---- Termination Process ----
    public void Close()
    {
        _grabber?.Dispose(); _grabber = null;
        _camera?.Dispose(); _camera = null;
        _discovery?.Dispose(); _discovery = null;
        _p = null;
    }
    public void Dispose() => Close();

    private void HeightCheckExample()
    {
        int lineCount = 2000; // User specified
        int linesPerFrame;

        // First, attempt the "setting value (HALCON equivalent)"
        if (!TryGetHeightNode(out linesPerFrame) || linesPerFrame <= 0)
        {
            // If unable to read, compensate with "actual measurement"
            TryProbeDeliveredHeight(out linesPerFrame, timeoutMsPerFrame);
        }

        // Final safeguard
        if (linesPerFrame <= 0) linesPerFrame = 1;

        // Required number of frames to satisfy the desired line count (Same as HALCON's formula)
        int loops = (lineCount + linesPerFrame - 1) / linesPerFrame;
    }

    // ① Read Height as a setting value from the GenICam node (HALCON equivalent)
    private bool TryGetHeightNode(out int height)
    {
        height = 0;
        try
        {
            double v = _p.GetFloat("Height"); // Replacement for GetFramegrabberParam("Height")
            height = (int)Math.Round(v);
            return height > 0;
        }
        catch { return false; }
    }

    // ② Measure Delivered line count from actual data (from the first arrived frame)
    private bool TryProbeDeliveredHeight(out int deliveredHeight, int timeoutMs)
    {
        deliveredHeight = 0;
        bool startedHere = false;
        if (!_grabber.IsStarted) { _grabber.Start(); startedHere = true; }

        try
        {
            var res = _grabber.GrabNext(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(timeoutMs));
            bool ok = false;
            int localHeight = 0; // ← Place outside the lambda

            res.IfCompleteFrame(frame =>
            {
                try
                {
                    var range = frame.GetRange();
                    if (range != null)
                    {
                        var comp = range.CopyUnpacked();
                        localHeight = (int)comp.GetDeliveredHeight();
                        ok = localHeight > 0;
                    }
                }
                finally { frame.Release(); }
            })
            .IfIncompleteFrame(f => { f.Release(); })
            .IfTimedOut(() => { });

            if (ok) deliveredHeight = localHeight; // ← Assign outside
            return ok;
        }
        finally
        {
            if (startedHere) _grabber.Stop();
        }
    }

    // Example Usage
    Ruler3000Lines _ctl;

    void BtnOpen_Click()
    {
        _ctl = new Ruler3000Lines();
        _ctl.Open(@"C:\SICK\TL\SICKGigEVisionTL.cti", "192.168.0.10");
        _ctl.ConfigureForExternalTrigger(exposureUs: 3000, triggerLine: "Line1");
    }

    void BtnGrab_Click()
    {
        int userLines = 2000; // ← User Input
                                // Raw U16 (for later mm conversion)
        var hmU16 = _ctl.CaptureLinesTiled(userLines, 200, useTransformed: false);

        // If direct mm is desired (returns after double->float conversion)
        // var hmMM = _ctl.CaptureLinesTiled(userLines, 200, useTransformed:true);

        // Display in PictureBox if necessary (using FloatToBitmap() as provided previously)
    }

}
```

```csharp using System; using System.Drawing; using System.Drawing.Imaging; using System.Runtime.InteropServices; using System.Windows.Forms;

public static class ImageUtilSafe
{
    // Common: Create 8bpp grayscale Bitmap and set palette
    // Generates an 8-bit grayscale Bitmap of the specified size and initializes the palette to grayscale
    private static Bitmap CreateGray8(int w, int h)
    {
        var bmp = new Bitmap(w, h, PixelFormat.Format8bppIndexed);
        var pal = bmp.Palette;
        for (int i = 0; i < 256; i++) pal.Entries[i] = Color.FromArgb(i, i, i); // Grayscale with R=G=B=i
        bmp.Palette = pal;
        return bmp;
    }

    // Common: Linear map to 0..255 (Robust even if min == max)
    // Normalizes value v from the range min to max into 0 to 255 and converts to byte. Avoids division by zero even if min == max
    private static byte MapToByte(float v, float min, float max)
    {
        float range = Math.Max(1e-6f, max - min); // Prevent division by zero
        int g = (int)((v - min) / range * 255f + 0.5f); // Linear transformation
        if (g < 0) g = 0; if (g > 255) g = 255; // Clip out-of-range values
        return (byte)g;
    }

    // -------- float[,] → 8bpp Bitmap --------
    /// <summary>
    /// Converts a 2D float array to an 8-bit grayscale Bitmap (min/max can be specified)
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="src">The float array, such as a height map</param>
    /// <param name="minOverride">Minimum display limit (automatically calculated if omitted)</param>
    /// <param name="maxOverride">Maximum display limit (automatically calculated if omitted)</param>
    /// <returns>The 8-bit grayscale Bitmap</returns>
    public static Bitmap FloatToBitmap(float[,] src, float? minOverride = null, float? maxOverride = null)
    {
        int h = src.GetLength(0), w = src.GetLength(1); // Array size
        // Automatic min/max calculation (Scan the entire array if not specified)
        float mn = minOverride ?? float.MaxValue, mx = maxOverride ?? float.MinValue;
        if (!minOverride.HasValue || !maxOverride.HasValue)
        {
            for (int y = 0; y < h; y++)
                for (int x = 0; x < w; x++)
                {
                    float v = src[y, x];
                    if (!minOverride.HasValue && v < mn) mn = v;
                    if (!maxOverride.HasValue && v > mx) mx = v;
                }
        }
        var bmp = CreateGray8(w, h); // Create Bitmap
        var bd = bmp.LockBits(new Rectangle(0, 0, w, h), ImageLockMode.WriteOnly, PixelFormat.Format8bppIndexed); // Lock pixel area
        try
        {
            int stride = bd.Stride; // Bytes per row (including padding)
            byte[] buf = new byte[stride * h]; // Working buffer
            for (int y = 0; y < h; y++)
            {
                int row = y * stride;
                for (int x = 0; x < w; x++)
                    buf[row + x] = MapToByte(src[y, x], mn, mx); // Convert to 0-255
            }
            Marshal.Copy(buf, 0, bd.Scan0, buf.Length); // Copy buffer to Bitmap
        }
        finally { bmp.UnlockBits(bd); } // Unlock
        return bmp;
    }

    // -------- ushort[,] → 8bpp Bitmap --------
    /// <summary>
    /// Converts a 2D ushort array to an 8-bit grayscale Bitmap (min/max can be specified)
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="src">The ushort array, such as a U16 image</param>
    /// <param name="minOverride">Minimum display limit (automatically calculated if omitted)</param>
    /// <param name="maxOverride">Maximum display limit (automatically calculated if omitted)</param>
    /// <returns>The 8-bit grayscale Bitmap</returns>
    public static Bitmap U16ToBitmap(ushort[,] src, ushort? minOverride = null, ushort? maxOverride = null)
    {
        int h = src.GetLength(0), w = src.GetLength(1); // Array size
        int mnI = minOverride.HasValue ? minOverride.Value : int.MaxValue;
        int mxI = maxOverride.HasValue ? maxOverride.Value : int.MinValue;
        // Automatic min/max calculation
        if (!minOverride.HasValue || !maxOverride.HasValue)
        {
            for (int y = 0; y < h; y++)
                for (int x = 0; x < w; x++)
                {
                    int v = src[y, x];
                    if (!minOverride.HasValue && v < mnI) mnI = v;
                    if (!maxOverride.HasValue && v > mxI) mxI = v;
                }
        }
        float mn = mnI, mx = mxI; // Convert to float
        var bmp = CreateGray8(w, h);
        var bd = bmp.LockBits(new Rectangle(0, 0, w, h), ImageLockMode.WriteOnly, PixelFormat.Format8bppIndexed);
        try
        {
            int stride = bd.Stride;
            byte[] buf = new byte[stride * h];
            for (int y = 0; y < h; y++)
            {
                int row = y * stride;
                for (int x = 0; x < w; x++)
                    buf[row + x] = MapToByte(src[y, x], mn, mx); // Convert to 0-255
            }
            Marshal.Copy(buf, 0, bd.Scan0, buf.Length);
        }
        finally { bmp.UnlockBits(bd); }
        return bmp;
    }

    // -------- double[,] (e.g., mm) → 8bpp Bitmap --------
    /// <summary>
    /// Converts a 2D double array (e.g., height map [mm]) to an 8-bit grayscale Bitmap (min/max can be specified)
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="src">The double array (e.g., Z value [mm])</param>
    /// <param name="minOverride">Minimum display limit (automatically calculated if omitted)</param>
    /// <param name="maxOverride">Maximum display limit (automatically calculated if omitted)</param>
    /// <returns>The 8-bit grayscale Bitmap</returns>
    public static Bitmap DoubleToBitmap(double[,] src, double? minOverride = null, double? maxOverride = null)
    {
        int h = src.GetLength(0), w = src.GetLength(1); // Array size
        double mnD = minOverride ?? double.MaxValue, mxD = maxOverride ?? double.MinValue;
        // Automatic min/max calculation
        if (!minOverride.HasValue || !maxOverride.HasValue)
        {
            for (int y = 0; y < h; y++)
                for (int x = 0; x < w; x++)
                {
                    double v = src[y, x];
                    if (!minOverride.HasValue && v < mnD) mnD = v;
                    if (!maxOverride.HasValue && v > mxD) mxD = v;
                }
        }
        float mn = (float)mnD, mx = (float)mxD; // Convert to float
        var bmp = CreateGray8(w, h);
        var bd = bmp.LockBits(new Rectangle(0, 0, w, h), ImageLockMode.WriteOnly, PixelFormat.Format8bppIndexed);
        try
        {
            int stride = bd.Stride;
            byte[] buf = new byte[stride * h];
            for (int y = 0; y < h; y++)
            {
                int row = y * stride;
                for (int x = 0; x < w; x++)
                    buf[row + x] = MapToByte((float)src[y, x], mn, mx); // Convert double->float and then to 0-255
            }
            Marshal.Copy(buf, 0, bd.Scan0, buf.Length);
        }
        finally { bmp.UnlockBits(bd); }
        return bmp;
    }
}


// Usage example
// float[,] hm = _ctl.CaptureLinesTiled(...);
// var bmp = ImageUtilSafe.FloatToBitmap(hm); // Auto range
// // var bmp = ImageUtilSafe.FloatToBitmap(hm, minOverride: 0f, maxOverride: 50f); // Fixed range
// pictureBox1.Image = bmp;
```

docs.title: C# 3
docs.text:
Usage and Important Notes

Channel order (AccessChannel number) is environment-dependent.

First, grab just one frame and determine which is Range/Intensity based on the size and bit depth. (For example, Range is 16-bit, Intensity is 8-bit, etc. This also depends on the Stream Setup settings.)

This code assumes 1 Grab = 1 line (height = 1px).

If your setup is for a 2D image containing multiple lines in 1 Grab, tile_images is unnecessary and the image will be used as a "height map" as is.

Bit Depth: If aiming for a few microns, Mono12/16 equivalent is strongly recommended (to ensure quantization fineness).

Match the PixelFormat to your camera settings and save as a 16-bit TIFF.

Converting Z to mm: Apply Z_mm = scale * DN + offset in a post-process (scale/offset are camera/stream setup values). Removing the tilt of the reference plane using plane fitting will result in tiny steps (scratches).

Reason for choosing asynchronous: At high line rates, acquisition and post-processing (linking/saving) can be separated, making it easier to avoid missing data. This asynchronous version is fine to start with. If you need even higher throughput, you can gradually improve it by saving and processing in a separate thread.

To switch to software trigger: Set TriggerMode="On", TriggerSource="Software", and execute SetFramegrabberParam(acq,"TriggerSoftware","execute") → GrabDataAsync(...) for each line.

```csharp

using System;
using HalconDotNet;

class GrabRangeIntensity_AsyncStack
{
    static void Main()
    {
        // === Adjust to your environment ===
        const string IFace    = "GigEVision2";            // e.g., "GigEVision2"
        const string Device   = "RULER3000_01";           // DeviceUserID or "169.254.x.x"
        const int    NumLines = 100;                      // Number of lines to acquire (assumes 1 grab = 1 line)
        const string SaveDir  = @"C:\temp\ruler_async";   // Save destination
        const string PixelFmt = "Mono16";                 // 12/16bit is recommended for micron-level precision (must match the camera)

        HTuple acq = null;
        HObject[] rangeLines = new HObject[NumLines];
        HObject[] intenLines = new HObject[NumLines];
        HObject rangeConcat = null, intenConcat = null;
        HObject rangeStack  = null, intenStack  = null;

        try
        {
            System.IO.Directory.CreateDirectory(SaveDir);

            // 1) Open the frame grabber
            HOperatorSet.OpenFramegrabber(
                IFace,
                0,0,0,0,0,0,
                "default",
                -1, "default", -1, "false",
                "default",
                Device,
                0, -1,
                out acq);

            // 2) Enable chunks & free run (can be changed to software trigger later if needed)
            TrySet(acq, "ChunkModeActive", "true");  // Receive Range+Intensity as a simultaneous payload
            TrySet(acq, "PixelFormat", PixelFmt);    // Must match the camera settings
            TrySet(acq, "TriggerMode", "Off");       // Start with free run

            // 3) Start asynchronous acquisition
            //    grab_data_start -> grab_data_async in a loop
            HOperatorSet.GrabDataStart(acq, -1);

            // 4) Acquisition loop: just acquire data here. Concatenation and tiling will be done later.
            for (int i = 0; i < NumLines; i++)
            {
                // -1 means "wait" for an indefinite period. Adjust to an appropriate value like milliseconds if needed.
                HObject imagesTuple;    // Contains (Range, Intensity, ...)
                HTuple  metaTuple;      // Metadata like 'mark'. Can be ignored if not used.
                HOperatorSet.GrabDataAsync(out imagesTuple, out metaTuple, acq, -1);

                // Extract Range / Intensity from the image tuple
                // * The channel order depends on the settings.
                //   Typically, [1]=Range and [2]=Intensity (1-based index), but verify if needed.
                HObject rangeImg, intenImg;
                HOperatorSet.AccessChannel(imagesTuple, out rangeImg, 1);  // 1st channel -> Range (assumed)
                HOperatorSet.AccessChannel(imagesTuple, out intenImg, 2);  // 2nd channel -> Intensity (assumed)

                // This assumes 1 Grab = 1 line (height = 1px)
                rangeLines[i] = rangeImg;
                intenLines[i] = intenImg;

                imagesTuple.Dispose(); // Release the tuple itself when no longer needed
                // metaTuple is HTuple, so no explicit release is needed
            }

            // 5) Concatenate -> tile in one go (vertical stack: Rows=NumLines, Cols=1)
            HOperatorSet.GenEmptyObj(out rangeConcat);
            HOperatorSet.GenEmptyObj(out intenConcat);

            for (int i = 0; i < NumLines; i++)
            {
                HObject tmp;
                HOperatorSet.ConcatObj(rangeConcat, rangeLines[i], out tmp);
                rangeConcat.Dispose(); rangeConcat = tmp;
                rangeLines[i].Dispose();

                HOperatorSet.ConcatObj(intenConcat, intenLines[i], out tmp);
                intenConcat.Dispose(); intenConcat = tmp;
                intenLines[i].Dispose();
            }

            HOperatorSet.TileImages(rangeConcat, out rangeStack, NumLines, 1);
            HOperatorSet.TileImages(intenConcat, out intenStack, NumLines, 1);

            // 6) Save as 16bit TIFF (PNG is also possible, but TIFF is safer for preserving 16bit data)
            string pathRange = System.IO.Path.Combine(SaveDir, "range_stack_async.tiff");
            string pathInten = System.IO.Path.Combine(SaveDir, "intensity_stack_async.tiff");

            HOperatorSet.WriteImage(rangeStack, "tiff", 0, pathRange);
            HOperatorSet.WriteImage(intenStack, "tiff", 0, pathInten);

            Console.WriteLine($"saved:\n  {pathRange}\n  {pathInten}");
        }
        finally
        {
            if (rangeStack  != null) rangeStack.Dispose();
            if (intenStack  != null) intenStack.Dispose();
            if (rangeConcat != null) rangeConcat.Dispose();
            if (intenConcat != null) intenConcat.Dispose();
            if (acq         != null) HOperatorSet.CloseFramegrabber(acq);
        }
    }

    // Utility to suppress errors if the interface doesn't support a parameter
    static void TrySet(HTuple acq, string name, string val)
    {
        try { HOperatorSet.SetFramegrabberParam(acq, name, val); } catch {}
    }
}

docs.text:
Usage & Notes

Assuming 1 Trigger = 1 line (height = 1px, width = W). If your setup uses "Multiple Lines (2D) per 1 Trigger," tile_images is not necessary.

The payload order (Range/Intensity) may change depending on your setup. The above code assumes #1 = Range, #2 = Intensity. First, check the log (GetImagePointer1) and replace SelectObj(..., 1/2) if necessary. (Since this is a multi-object image, use SelectObj instead of AccessChannel.)

Timeout: Adjust TimeoutMs (this will vary depending on the line rate and exposure).

PixelFormat/BitDepth: Mono12/16 is recommended for µm-level resolution. Save as 16-bit TIFF.

The standard procedure is to convert to mm and remove surface tilt at a later stage: Z_mm = scale * DN + offset, and then create a small step by fitting the reference surface to a plane.

```csharp

using System;
using HalconDotNet;

class GrabRI_SoftwareTrigger_Async
{
    static void Main()
    {
        // ====== Adjust to your environment ======
        const string IFace    = "GigEVision2";            // Usually "GigEVision2"
        const string Device   = "RULER3000_01";           // DeviceUserID or "169.254.x.x"
        const int    NumLines = 100;                      // Number of lines to acquire (assumes 1 trigger = 1 line)
        const string SaveDir  = @"C:\temp\ruler_swtrg";   // Save destination
        const string PixelFmt = "Mono16";                 // 12/16bit recommended for micron-level precision (must match camera)
        const int    TimeoutMs = 2000;                    // Timeout for GrabDataAsync (ms)
        const bool   Verbose  = true;                     // Log for checking channel order

        HTuple acq = null;
        HObject[] rangeLines = new HObject[NumLines];
        HObject[] intenLines = new HObject[NumLines];
        HObject imagesMO = null; // Temporary: container for multi-object
        HObject rangeConcat = null, intenConcat = null;
        HObject rangeStack  = null, intenStack  = null;

        try
        {
            System.IO.Directory.CreateDirectory(SaveDir);

            // 1) Open framegrabber
            HOperatorSet.OpenFramegrabber(
                IFace,
                0,0,0,0,0,0,
                "default",
                -1, "default", -1, "false",
                "default",
                Device,
                0, -1,
                out acq);

            // 2) Parameters (software trigger & simultaneous chunk acquisition)
            TrySet(acq, "ChunkModeActive", "true");        // Range+Intensity as simultaneous payload
            TrySet(acq, "PixelFormat", PixelFmt);         // Must match camera settings (e.g., Mono16)
            TrySet(acq, "AcquisitionMode", "SingleFrame"); // Assumes 1 Trigger = 1 Frame (ignore if not available)
            TrySet(acq, "TriggerSelector", "FrameStart");   // Select FrameStart trigger (ignore if not available)
            TrySet(acq, "TriggerMode", "On");
            TrySet(acq, "TriggerSource", "Software");       // Use software trigger

            // 3) Start asynchronous acquisition (buffer rotation)
            HOperatorSet.GrabDataStart(acq, -1);

            // 4) Loop: Trigger -> Asynchronous acquisition (only acquire. Concatenate & tile later)
            for (int i = 0; i < NumLines; i++)
            {
                // 4-1) Issue a software trigger
                HOperatorSet.SetFramegrabberParam(acq, "TriggerSoftware", "execute");

                // 4-2) Receive (Range+Intensity simultaneously)
                HObject imagesTuple; // multi-object (a tuple of multiple objects)
                HTuple  metaTuple;   // Metadata like 'mark' (can be ignored if not used)

                HOperatorSet.GrabDataAsync(out imagesTuple, out metaTuple, acq, TimeoutMs);

                // 4-3) Extraction: Extract Range / Intensity from the multi-object
                //      ★IMPORTANT★ grab_data returns a "multi-object of images".
                //      -> The correct way to extract is using SelectObj, NOT AccessChannel.
                //      (The channel order is environment-dependent. Check with the initial log.)
                int nObj;
                HOperatorSet.CountObj(imagesTuple, out nObj);

                if (nObj < 2)
                    throw new Exception($"Expected at least 2 payloads (Range & Intensity), but got {nObj}");

                // Check: Log size and type only on the first run
                if (Verbose && i == 0)
                {
                    for (int k = 1; k <= nObj; k++)
                    {
                        HObject ch; HOperatorSet.SelectObj(imagesTuple, out ch, k);
                        HTuple type, w, h;
                        HOperatorSet.GetImagePointer1(ch, out _, out type, out w, out h);
                        Console.WriteLine($"[DBG] payload #{k}: {type.S} {w}x{h}");
                        ch.Dispose();
                    }
                }

                // Here we assume #1 is Range and #2 is Intensity (*swap if necessary)
                HOperatorSet.SelectObj(imagesTuple, out HObject rangeImg, 1);
                HOperatorSet.SelectObj(imagesTuple, out HObject intenImg, 2);

                // Assuming 1 Trigger = 1 line (height = 1px)
                rangeLines[i] = rangeImg;
                intenLines[i] = intenImg;

                imagesTuple.Dispose(); // Dispose of the main multi-object when no longer needed
            }

            // 5) Concatenate -> tile in one go (vertical stack)
            HOperatorSet.GenEmptyObj(out rangeConcat);
            HOperatorSet.GenEmptyObj(out intenConcat);

            for (int i = 0; i < NumLines; i++)
            {
                HOperatorSet.ConcatObj(rangeConcat, rangeLines[i], out HObject tmpR);
                rangeConcat.Dispose(); rangeConcat = tmpR;
                rangeLines[i].Dispose();

                HOperatorSet.ConcatObj(intenConcat, intenLines[i], out HObject tmpI);
                intenConcat.Dispose(); intenConcat = tmpI;
                intenLines[i].Dispose();
            }

            HOperatorSet.TileImages(rangeConcat, out rangeStack, NumLines, 1);
            HOperatorSet.TileImages(intenConcat, out intenStack, NumLines, 1);

            // 6) Save as 16bit TIFF
            string pathRange = System.IO.Path.Combine(SaveDir, "range_stack_swtrg_async.tiff");
            string pathInten = System.IO.Path.Combine(SaveDir, "intensity_stack_swtrg_async.tiff");

            HOperatorSet.WriteImage(rangeStack, "tiff", 0, pathRange);
            HOperatorSet.WriteImage(intenStack, "tiff", 0, pathInten);

            Console.WriteLine($"saved:\n  {pathRange}\n  {pathInten}");
        }
        finally
        {
            imagesMO?.Dispose();
            rangeStack?.Dispose();
            intenStack?.Dispose();
            rangeConcat?.Dispose();
            intenConcat?.Dispose();
            if (acq != null) HOperatorSet.CloseFramegrabber(acq);
        }
    }

    static void TrySet(HTuple acq, string name, string val)
    {
        try { HOperatorSet.SetFramegrabberParam(acq, name, val); }
        catch { /* Ignore if the I/F doesn't support it */ }
    }
}

docs.title: クローン（リモートからコピーを作る）
docs.text:
git clone git@server:/path/to/repo.git

実行後、repo というフォルダが作成され、その中にリポジトリの内容がコピーされます

docs.title: 既存のブランチを見る
docs.text: git branch # ローカルのブランチ git branch -r # リモートのブランチ

docs.title: 既存のリモートブランチに切り替える場合
docs.text: git checkout -b your-branch-name origin/your-branch-name

docs.title: 変更を確認
docs.text: git status

docs.title: ステージに追加（追跡対象に）
docs.text: git add main.cpp # 個別に追加 git add . # 全部まとめて追加

docs.title: コミット（ローカル履歴に記録）
docs.text: git commit -m "機能追加: メイン処理を実装"

docs.title: 最新の情報だけ反映（安全）
docs.text:
git fetch --prune --tags

--prune：リモートで削除されたブランチの追跡ブランチ（例：origin/old-feature）をローカルからも掃除します --tags：すべてのタグを取得します

git log --oneline --graph --decorate --all

「hogeブランチ が main にマージ済みかどうか」の判定方法 その中に「Merge branch 'feature/hoge'」といったメッセージがあれば、マージ済み

git log main --merges --oneline

「現在いるローカルブランチ」と「origin/main」のファイル差分を表示

git diff origin/main

docs.title: リモートにプッシュ（アップロード）
docs.text:
git push origin your-branch-name origin：リモートリポジトリの名前（通常は origin のまま）

上流（upstream）が未設定の場合

The current branch hoge has no upstream branch.

のようなエラーが出る → 一度でも上流設定を済ませれば、その後は git push だけでOK

git push -u origin your-branch-name

あるいは

git push -u origin HEAD # 今いるブランチ名を自動で使う

docs.title: 2回目以降
docs.text: git push # もう -u は不要。普通に通る git pull --rebase # 追従時

docs.title: 他の人の更新を取り込む（プル）
docs.text: git pull origin your-branch-name

docs.title: マージ
docs.text:
例: feature ブランチを main に取り込む(featureが消えてmainが残る) git checkout main git merge feature

※リモートの最新状態を知りたいなら、まず git fetch が必要

docs.title: git fetch
docs.text: リモートの最新状況を取得してローカルに記録するだけ（作業中ブランチは一切触らない） リモート追跡ブランチ（例：origin/main, origin/feature/hoge）が更新される ワーキングツリー/現在のブランチは変化なし 安全に「最新を観察」できる

docs.title: git pull
docs.text: = git fetch ＋ 現在のブランチを更新（マージ or リベース） デフォルトは fetch後に「マージ」 設定しだいで fetch後に「リベース」 へ変更可能 作業中のブランチに変更が入りうる（コンフリクトも起きうる） git pull は「現在のブランチ」しか更新しない

docs.title: まとめ
docs.text:
# 1. 最新のリモート情報を取る
git fetch --prune --tags

# 2. main を最新化
git switch main
git pull --rebase   # main を origin/main に追従

# 3. 再び hoge ブランチに戻る
git switch feature/hoge

# 4. main の最新を取り込む（リベース推奨）
git rebase main
# or マージする場合は: git merge main

# 5. リモートに更新を反映
git push --force-with-lease   # rebase したなら必須
# or
git push                      # merge したならこれでOK

docs.title: Go
docs.text:
Here is a basic code example for implementing the server side in Go. In this example, we will create a simple web server with the following functions.

GET / : Returns “Hello, World!”

GET /users : Returns a list of users in JSON format

POST /users : Adds a user (accepts JSON)

```go

package main

import (
    "encoding/json"
    "fmt"
    "log"
    "net/http"
)

// User model
type User struct {
    ID   int    `json:"id"`
    Name string `json:"name"`
}

var users = []User{
    {ID: 1, Name: "Alice"},
    {ID: 2, Name: "Bob"},
}

// Handler: "/" → return Hello, World!
func helloHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
    fmt.Fprintln(w, "Hello, World!")
}

// Handler: "/users" (GET) → return user list
func getUsersHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
    w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
    json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(users)
}

// Handler: "/users" (POST) → add a new user
func createUserHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
    if r.Method != http.MethodPost {
        http.Error(w, "Method Not Allowed", http.StatusMethodNotAllowed)
        return
    }

    var newUser User
    if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&newUser); err != nil {
        http.Error(w, "Bad Request", http.StatusBadRequest)
        return
    }

    newUser.ID = len(users) + 1
    users = append(users, newUser)

    w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
    w.WriteHeader(http.StatusCreated)
    json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(newUser)
}

func main() {
    http.HandleFunc("/", helloHandler)
    http.HandleFunc("/users", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
        if r.Method == http.MethodGet {
            getUsersHandler(w, r)
        } else if r.Method == http.MethodPost {
            createUserHandler(w, r)
        } else {
            http.Error(w, "Method Not Allowed", http.StatusMethodNotAllowed)
        }
    })

    fmt.Println("🚀 Server is running at http://localhost:8080")
    log.Fatal(http.ListenAndServe(":8080", nil))
}
